title: PNP-CIDG issues 40 subpoenas over 521-kg Laos shabu shipment

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine National Police (PNP) Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) has issued 40 subpoenas in connection with the 521-kilogram shabu (methamphetamine) shipment intercepted from Laos. CIDG Director PMGen. Robert Alexander Morico II said 11 of those subpoenaed were among the “persons of interest” previously identified by Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla. “There are about 40 subpoenas that were issued sa case na ito. Yung previous na sinabi is 21 but there were more but not all of them are persons of interest,” Morico told reporters on Wednesday.
